verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents programmatic control on two fronts. It ships pip-installable Python packages and standalone scripts that control robots and environments, with headless operation and workflow automation (docs-12, docs-32, docs-42, docs-33). It also exposes ROS 2 services and actions to load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations (docs-4). missing for 10: API reference depth (no endpoint/class reference excerpts in evidence), no network/REST API or OpenAPI spec (probes 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving it via the API.
